description: The lamp's JMRI system name, which is also its jmri_name in the device master. Listed once. Its device ID is panel:<item>:<system_name>, the item being the panel_items.json item whose icon shows it (hartlib.device_ids.panel_id).
sensor for a sensor lamp, head for a signal head lamp: the device master's layer.
The JMRI user name, which panel_status.py finds the lamp by. Unique in the file.
field for a bean on the layout's buses, virtual for an internal one (IS:).
The icon attribute that names the lamp in panel_items.json: sensor (a sensoricon naming its user name) for a sensor, signalhead (a signalheadicon naming its system name) for a head.
The JMRI comment the tables give the bean.
The device master's description of the row: what the lamp shows.
